## HL · CRM import cleaner (Lesson 5.8)
Lesson 5.8 is built in HubSpot's screens, not in n8n. This helper does the Card 4 checklist on the Growth Desk leads sheet so the import is clean, and splits it into Import · Companies, Import · Contacts and Import · Deals tabs (import in that order), plus Import · Problems to fix by hand. The first 10 people are marked batch 1: import those, check the associations, then the rest.

It sends nothing and changes nothing in HubSpot.

Credentials: Google Sheets.
Placeholders: YOUR_SHEET_ID (tab Leads export with columns name, email, phone, company, website, business_type, lead_source, delivery_zone, marketing_consent, consent_date, deal_stage, weekly_value_ngn, owner, next_step_date, lost_reason, role).

## Do these in HubSpot (the solved problem)
1. One-page design agreed with Tolu: contacts, companies, deals; 5 stages with exit rules; up to 10 custom properties; owners Tolu and Bisi (households); four dashboard numbers.
2. Sign up with Harvest Lane's own domain email. Settings -> Objects -> Deals -> Pipelines: New enquiry 10%, Tasting booked 25%, Proposal sent 50%, Trial order 75%, Won 100% / Lost 0%. (Zoho: Setup -> Customization -> Pipelines.)
3. Properties (8, all dropdowns or numbers/dates): Contact lead_source, marketing_consent (yes/no/unknown), consent_date. Company business_type, delivery_zone (in/out). Deal weekly_value_ngn, lost_reason, next_step_date.
4. Import companies, then contacts (matched to companies by domain), then open deals. 10 rows first; check each deal shows its company and contact.
5. Owner on every open deal. Saved view: My deals needing a next step. HubSpot mobile app on Tolu's phone; log one call together.
6. Dashboard: open deal value by stage; deals in the same stage over 14 days; won and lost this month with reasons; new deals by lead_source. 20-minute Monday review for four weeks.
